name: Adaptability
effect: Powers up moves of the same type as the Pokémon.
short_effect: Increases the same-type attack bonus from 1.5× to 2×.

name: Aerilate
effect: Normal-type moves become Flying-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
short_effect: Turns the bearer's Normal moves into Flying moves and strengthens them to 1.3× their power.

name: Aftermath
effect: Damages the attacker if it knocks out the Pokémon with a move that makes direct contact.
short_effect: Damages the attacker for 1/4 its max HP when knocked out by a contact move.

name: Air Lock
effect: Eliminates the effects of weather.
short_effect: Negates all effects of weather, but does not prevent the weather itself.

name: Analytic
effect: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's move if it is the last to act that turn.
short_effect: Strengthens moves to 1.3× their power when moving last.

name: Anger Point
effect: The Pokémon is angered when it takes a critical hit, and that maxes its Attack stat.
short_effect: Raises Attack to the maximum of six stages upon receiving a critical hit.

name: Anger Shell
effect: When an attack causes its HP to drop to half or less, the Pokémon gets angry. This lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.
short_effect: When the Pokémon's HP drops below half, Anger Shell lowers its Defense and Special Defense but its Attack, Special Attack and Speed are raised.

name: Anticipation
effect: The Pokémon can sense an opposing Pokémon's dangerous moves.
short_effect: Notifies all trainers upon entering battle if an opponent has a super-effective move, Self-Destruct, Explosion, or a one-hit KO move.

name: Arena Trap
effect: Prevents opposing Pokémon from fleeing from battle.
short_effect: Prevents opponents from fleeing or switching out.  Eluded by Flying-types and Pokémon in the air.

name: Armor Tail
effect: The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon's head makes opponents unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.
short_effect: Prevents the opponent from using any moves that have priority, such as Quick Attack.

name: Aroma Veil
effect: Protects the Pokémon and its allies from effects that prevent the use of moves.
short_effect: Protects allies against moves that affect their mental state.

name: As One
effect: This Ability combines the effects of both Calyrex's Unnerve Ability and Spectrier's Grim Neigh Ability.
short_effect: Combines the effects of Unnerve and Grim Neigh.

name: As One
effect: This Ability combines the effects of both Calyrex's Unnerve Ability and Glastrier's Chilling Neigh Ability.
short_effect: Combines the effects of Unnerve and Chilling Neigh.

name: Aura Break
effect: The effects of “Aura” Abilities are reversed to lower the power of affected moves.
short_effect: Makes Dark Aura and Fairy Aura weaken moves of their respective types.

name: Aura Guard
effect: A Pokémon with Aura Guard takes half damage from moves that make contact. Moves affected by Long Reach which make contact will deal regular damage.
short_effect: A Pokémon with Aura Guard takes half damage from moves that make contact.

name: Bad Dreams
effect: Damages opposing Pokémon that are asleep.
short_effect: Damages sleeping opponents for 1/8 their max HP after each turn.

name: Ball Fetch
effect: If the Pokémon is not holding an item, it will fetch the Poké Ball from the first failed throw of the battle.
short_effect: If the Pokémon is not holding an item, it will fetch the Poké Ball from the first failed throw of the battle.

name: Battery
effect: Powers up ally Pokémon's special moves.
short_effect: Ally Pokémon's moves have their power increased to 1.3×.

name: Battle Armor
effect: Hard armor protects the Pokémon from critical hits.
short_effect: Protects against critical hits.

name: Battle Bond
effect: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, its bond with its Trainer is strengthened, and its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats are boosted.
short_effect: Transforms this Pokémon into Ash-Greninja after fainting an opponent.  Water Shuriken's power is 20 and always hits three times.

name: Beads of Ruin
effect: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous beads lowers the Sp. Def stats of all Pokémon except itself.
short_effect: Lowers Special Defense of all Pokémon except itself.

name: Beast Boost
effect: The Pokémon boosts its most proficient stat each time it knocks out a Pokémon.
short_effect: Raises this Pokémon's highest stat by one stage when it faints another Pokémon.

name: Berserk
effect: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat when it takes a hit that causes its HP to drop to half or less.
short_effect: Raises this Pokémon's Special Attack by one stage every time its HP drops below half.

name: Big Pecks
effect: Prevents the Pokémon from having its Defense stat lowered.
short_effect: Protects against Defense drops.

name: Blaze
effect: Powers up Fire-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.
short_effect: Strengthens Fire moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

name: Bulletproof
effect: Protects the Pokémon from ball and bomb moves.
short_effect: Protects against bullet, ball, and bomb-based moves.

name: Cheek Pouch
effect: The Pokémon's HP is restored when it eats any Berry, in addition to the Berry's usual effect.
short_effect: Restores HP upon eating a Berry, in addition to the Berry's effect.

name: Chilling Neigh
effect: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a chilling neigh, which boosts its Attack stat.
short_effect: Boosts Attack after knocking out a Pokémon.

name: Chlorophyll
effect: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in harsh sunlight.
short_effect: Doubles Speed during strong sunlight.

name: Clear Body
effect: Prevents other Pokémon's moves or Abilities from lowering the Pokémon's stats.
short_effect: Prevents stats from being lowered by other Pokémon.

name: Cloud Nine
effect: Eliminates the effects of weather.
short_effect: Negates all effects of weather, but does not prevent the weather itself.

name: Color Change
effect: The Pokémon’s type becomes the type of the move used on it.
short_effect: Changes type to match when hit by a damaging move.

name: Comatose
effect: The Pokémon is always drowsing and will never wake up. It can attack while in its sleeping state.
short_effect: This Pokémon always  acts as though it were Asleep.

name: Commander
effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it goes inside the mouth of an ally Dondozo if one is on the field. The Pokémon then issues commands from there.
short_effect: Goes inside the mouth of an ally Dondozo if one is on the field.

name: Competitive
effect: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat sharply when its stats are lowered by an opposing Pokémon.
short_effect: Raises Special Attack by two stages upon having any stat lowered.

name: Compound Eyes
effect: The Pokémon's compound eyes boost its accuracy.
short_effect: Increases moves' accuracy to 1.3×.

name: Contrary
effect: Reverses any stat changes affecting the Pokémon so that attempts to boost its stats instead lower them—and attempts to lower its stats will boost them.
short_effect: Inverts stat changes.

name: Corrosion
effect: The Pokémon can poison the target even if it's a Steel or Poison type.
short_effect: This Pokémon can inflict poison on Poison and Steel Pokémon.

name: Costar
effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it copies an ally's stat changes.
short_effect: Copies ally's stat changes on entering battle.

name: Cotton Down
effect: When the Pokémon is hit by an attack, it scatters cotton fluff around and lowers the Speed stat of all Pokémon except itself.
short_effect: When Ignores moves and abilities that draw in moves.

name: Cud Chew
effect: When the Pokémon eats a Berry, it will regurgitate that Berry at the end of the next turn and eat it one more time.
short_effect: Causes the Pokémon to reuse an already consumed Berry at the end of the next turn.

name: Curious Medicine
effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it scatters medicine from its shell, which removes all stat changes from allies.
short_effect: Resets all stat changes upon entering battlefield.

name: Cursed Body
effect: May disable a move that has dealt damage to the Pokémon.
short_effect: Has a 30% chance of Disabling any move that hits the Pokémon.

name: Cute Charm
effect: The Pokémon may infatuate attackers that make direct contact with it.
short_effect: Has a 30% chance of infatuating attacking Pokémon on contact.

name: Damp
effect: The Pokémon dampens its surroundings, preventing all Pokémon from using explosive moves such as Self-Destruct.
short_effect: Prevents Self-Destruct, Explosion, and Aftermath from working while the Pokémon is in battle.

name: Dancer
effect: Whenever a dance move is used in battle, the Pokémon will copy the user to immediately perform that dance move itself.
short_effect: Whenever another Pokémon uses a dance move, this Pokémon will use the same move immediately afterwards.

name: Dark Aura
effect: Powers up each Pokémon’s Dark-type moves.
short_effect: Strengthens Dark moves to 1.33× their power for all friendly and opposing Pokémon.

name: Dauntless Shield
effect: Boosts the Pokémon’s Defense stat the first time the Pokémon enters a battle.
short_effect: Boosts Defense in battle.

name: Dazzling
effect: The Pokémon dazzles its opponents, making them unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.
short_effect: Opposing Pokémon cannot use priority attacks.

name: Defeatist
effect: Halves the Pokémon’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats when its HP becomes half or less.
short_effect: Halves Attack and Special Attack at 50% max HP or less.

name: Defiant
effect: If the Pokémon has any stat lowered by an opposing Pokémon, its Attack stat will be boosted sharply.
short_effect: Raises Attack two stages upon having any stat lowered.

name: Delta Stream
effect: The Pokémon changes the weather to eliminate all of the Flying type’s weaknesses.
short_effect: Creates a mysterious air current, which cannot be replaced and causes moves to never be super effective against Flying Pokémon.

name: Desolate Land
effect: The Pokémon changes the weather to nullify Water-type attacks.
short_effect: Creates extremely harsh sunlight, which has all the properties of Sunny Day, cannot be replaced, and causes damaging Water moves to fail.

name: Disguise
effect: Once per battle, the shroud that covers the Pokémon can protect it from an attack.
short_effect: Prevents the first instance of battle damage.

name: Download
effect: The Pokémon compares an opposing Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats before raising its own Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever will be more effective.
short_effect: Raises the attack stat corresponding to the opponents' weaker defense one stage upon entering battle.

name: Dragonize
effect: The Pokémon's Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.
short_effect: The Pokémon's Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

name: Dragon’s Maw
effect: Powers up Dragon-type moves.
short_effect: Powers up Dragon-type moves.

name: Drizzle
effect: The Pokémon makes it rain when it enters a battle.
short_effect: Summons rain that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.

name: Drought
effect: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle.
short_effect: Summons strong sunlight that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.

name: Dry Skin
effect: Restores the Pokémon's HP in rain or when it is hit by Water-type moves. Reduces HP in harsh sunlight, and increases the damage received from Fire-type moves.
short_effect: Causes 1/8 max HP in damage each turn during strong sunlight, but heals for 1/8 max HP during rain.  Increases damage from Fire moves to 1.25×, but absorbs Water moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.

name: Early Bird
effect: The Pokémon awakens from sleep twice as fast as other Pokémon.
short_effect: Makes sleep pass twice as quickly.

name: Earth Eater
effect: If hit by a Ground-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.
short_effect: Restores HP when hit by a Ground-type move.

name: Eelevate
effect: The Pokémon floats off the ground, making it immune to Ground-type moves, as well as the Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web statuses. When the Pokémon knocks out a target with an attack, its highest stat is boosted by 1 stage.
short_effect: The Pokémon floats off the ground, making it immune to Ground-type moves, as well as the Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web statuses. When the Pokémon knocks out a target with an attack, its highest stat is boosted by 1 stage.

name: Effect Spore
effect: Contact with the Pokémon may inflict poison, sleep, or paralysis on the attacker.
short_effect: Has a 30% chance of inflcting either paralysis, poison, or sleep on attacking Pokémon on contact.

name: Electric Surge
effect: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.
short_effect: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Electric Terrain.

name: Electromorphosis
effect: The Pokémon becomes charged when it takes damage, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.
short_effect: When hit by an attack, the power of the next Electric-type move it uses is doubled.

name: Embody Aspect
effect: The Pokémon's heart fills with memories, causing the Mask to shine and one of the Pokémon's stats to be boosted.
short_effect: Embody Aspect boosts a particular stat, depending on the form of a Terastallized Ogerpon

name: Emergency Exit
effect: The Pokémon, sensing danger, switches out when its HP becomes half or less.
short_effect: This Pokémon automatically switches out when its HP drops below half.

name: Fairy Aura
effect: Powers up each Pokémon’s Fairy-type moves.
short_effect: Strengthens Fairy moves to 1.33× their power for all friendly and opposing Pokémon.

name: Filter
effect: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks that hit the Pokémon.
short_effect: Decreases damage taken from super-effective moves by 1/4.

name: Fire Mane
effect: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's Fire-type moves by 50%.
short_effect: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's Fire-type moves by 50%.

name: Flame Body
effect: Contact with the Pokémon may burn the attacker.
short_effect: Has a 30% chance of burning attacking Pokémon on contact.

name: Flare Boost
effect: Powers up special moves when the Pokémon is burned.
short_effect: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× when burned.

name: Flash Fire
effect: If hit by a Fire-type move, the Pokémon absorbs the flames and uses them to power up its own Fire-type moves.
short_effect: Protects against Fire moves.  Once one has been blocked, the Pokémon's own Fire moves inflict 1.5× damage until it leaves battle.

name: Flower Gift
effect: Boosts the Attack and Sp. Def stats of itself and allies in harsh sunlight.
short_effect: Increases friendly Pokémon's Attack and Special Defense to 1.5× during strong sunlight.

name: Flower Veil
effect: Ally Grass-type Pokémon are protected from status conditions and the lowering of their stats.
short_effect: Protects friendly Grass Pokémon from having their stats lowered by other Pokémon.

name: Fluffy
effect: Halves the damage taken from moves that make direct contact, but doubles that of Fire-type moves.
short_effect: Damage from contact moves is halved.  Damage from Fire moves is doubled.

name: Forecast
effect: The Pokémon transforms with the weather to change its type to Water, Fire, or Ice.
short_effect: Changes Castform's type and form to match the weather.

name: Forewarn
effect: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can tell one of the moves an opposing Pokémon has.
short_effect: Reveals the opponents' strongest move upon entering battle.

name: Friend Guard
effect: Reduces damage dealt to allies.
short_effect: Decreases all direct damage taken by friendly Pokémon to 0.75×.

name: Frisk
effect: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can check an opposing Pokémon's held item.
short_effect: Reveals an opponent's held item upon entering battle.

name: Full Metal Body
effect: Prevents other Pokémon’s moves or Abilities from lowering the Pokémon’s stats.
short_effect: Other Pokémon cannot lower this Pokémon's stats.

name: Fur Coat
effect: Halves the damage from physical moves.
short_effect: Halves damage from physical attacks.

name: Gale Wings
effect: Gives priority to the Pokémon's Flying-type moves while its HP is full.
short_effect: Raises Flying moves' priority by one stage.

name: Galvanize
effect: Normal-type moves become Electric-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
short_effect: This Pokémon's Normal moves are Electric and have their power increased to 1.2×.

name: Gluttony
effect: If the Pokémon is holding a Berry to be eaten when its HP is low, it will instead eat the Berry when its HP drops to half or less.
short_effect: Makes the Pokémon eat any held Berry triggered by low HP below 1/2 its max HP.

name: Good as Gold
effect: A body of pure, solid gold gives the Pokémon full immunity to other Pokémon's status moves.
short_effect: Gives immunity to status moves.

name: Gooey
effect: Contact with the Pokémon lowers the attacker's Speed stat.
short_effect: Lowers attacking Pokémon's Speed by one stage on contact.

name: Gorilla Tactics
effect: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat but only allows the use of the first selected move.
short_effect: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat but only allows the use of the first selected move.

name: Grass Pelt
effect: Boosts the Pokémon's Defense stat on Grassy Terrain.
short_effect: Boosts Defense while Grassy Terrain is in effect.

name: Grassy Surge
effect: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.
short_effect: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Grassy Terrain.

name: Grim Neigh
effect: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a terrifying neigh, which boosts its Sp. Atk stat.
short_effect: Boosts Special Attack after knocking out a Pokémon.

name: Guard Dog
effect: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if intimidated. Moves and items that would force the Pokémon to switch out also fail to work.
short_effect: Boosts Attack if intimidated, and prevents being forced to switch out.

name: Gulp Missile
effect: When the Pokémon uses Surf or Dive, it will come back with prey. When it takes damage, it will spit out the prey to attack.
short_effect: If a Cramorant with Gulp Missile uses Surf or Dive, it catches prey and changes its form depending on its remaining HP.

name: Guts
effect: It's so gutsy that having a status condition boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat.
short_effect: Increases Attack to 1.5× with a major status ailment.

name: Hadron Engine
effect: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle. The futuristic engine within the Pokémon also boosts its Sp. Atk stat on Electric Terrain.
short_effect: Creates an Electric Terrain when entering battle, and boosts Special Attack while active.

name: Harvest
effect: May create another Berry after one is used.
short_effect: Has a 50% chance of restoring a used Berry after each turn if the Pokémon has held no items in the meantime.

name: Healer
effect: Sometimes cures the status conditions of the Pokémon's allies.
short_effect: Has a 30% chance of curing each adjacent ally of any major status ailment after each turn.

name: Heatproof
effect: The Pokémon's heatproof body halves the damage taken from Fire-type moves.
short_effect: Halves damage from Fire moves and burns.

name: Heavy Metal
effect: Doubles the Pokémon's weight.
short_effect: Doubles the Pokémon's weight.

name: Honey Gather
effect: The Pokémon may gather Honey after a battle.
short_effect: The Pokémon may pick up Honey after battle.

name: Hospitality
effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring a small amount of the ally's HP
short_effect: When a Pokémon with Hospitality enters a battle, it restores HP for an ally by 25%.

name: Huge Power
effect: Doubles the Pokémon's Attack stat.
short_effect: Doubles Attack in battle.

name: Hunger Switch
effect: The Pokémon changes its form, alternating between its Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode after the end of every turn.
short_effect: Causes Morpeko to change its form each turn, alternating between Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode

name: Hustle
effect: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat but lowers its accuracy.
short_effect: Strengthens physical moves to inflict 1.5× damage, but decreases their accuracy to 0.8×.

name: Hydration
effect: Cures the Pokémon's status conditions in rain.
short_effect: Cures any major status ailment after each turn during rain.

name: Hyper Cutter
effect: The Pokémon's prized, mighty pincers prevent other Pokémon from lowering its Attack stat.
short_effect: Prevents Attack from being lowered by other Pokémon.

name: Ice Body
effect: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in snow.
short_effect: Heals for 1/16 max HP after each turn during hail.  Protects against hail damage.

name: Ice Face
effect: The Pokémon's ice head can take a physical attack as a substitute, but the attack also changes the Pokémon's appearance. The ice will be restored when it snows.
short_effect: The Pokémon’s ice head can take a physical attack as a substitute, but the attack also changes the Pokémon’s appearance. The ice will be restored when it snows.

name: Ice Scales
effect: The Pokémon is protected by ice scales, which halve the damage taken from special moves.
short_effect: Halves damage from Special moves.

name: Illuminate
effect: By illuminating its surroundings, the Pokémon prevents its accuracy from being lowered.
short_effect: Doubles the wild encounter rate.

name: Illusion
effect: The Pokémon fools opponents by entering battle disguised as the last Pokémon in its Trainer's party.
short_effect: Takes the appearance of the last conscious party Pokémon upon being sent out until hit by a damaging move.

name: Immunity
effect: The Pokémon's immune system prevents it from being poisoned.
short_effect: Prevents poison.

name: Imposter
effect: The Pokémon transforms itself into the Pokémon it's facing.
short_effect: Transforms upon entering battle.

name: Infiltrator
effect: The Pokémon's moves are unaffected by the target's barriers, substitutes, and the like.
short_effect: Bypasses Light Screen, Reflect, and Safeguard.

name: Innards Out
effect: Damages the attacker landing the finishing hit by the amount equal to its last HP.
short_effect: When this Pokémon faints from an opponent's move, that opponent takes damage equal to the HP this Pokémon had remaining.

name: Inner Focus
effect: The Pokémon's intense focus prevents it from flinching or being affected by Intimidate.
short_effect: Prevents flinching.

name: Insomnia
effect: The Pokémon's insomnia prevents it from falling asleep.
short_effect: Prevents sleep.

name: Intimidate
effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it intimidates opposing Pokémon and makes them cower, lowering their Attack stats.
short_effect: Lowers opponents' Attack one stage upon entering battle.

name: Intrepid Sword
effect: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat the first time the Pokémon enters a battle.
short_effect: Boosts Attack in battle.

name: Iron Barbs
effect: Inflicts damage on the attacker upon contact with iron barbs.
short_effect: Damages attacking Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP on contact.

name: Iron Fist
effect: Powers up punching moves.
short_effect: Strengthens punch-based moves to 1.2× their power.

name: Justified
effect: When the Pokémon is hit by a Dark-type attack, its Attack stat is boosted by its sense of justice.
short_effect: Raises Attack one stage upon taking damage from a Dark move.

name: Keen Eye
effect: The Pokémon's keen eyes prevent its accuracy from being lowered.
short_effect: Prevents accuracy from being lowered.

name: Klutz
effect: The Pokémon can't use any held items.
short_effect: Prevents the Pokémon from using its held item in battle.

name: Leaf Guard
effect: Prevents status conditions in harsh sunlight.
short_effect: Protects against major status ailments during strong sunlight.

name: Levitate
effect: By floating in the air, the Pokémon receives full immunity to all Ground-type moves.
short_effect: Evades Ground moves.

name: Libero
effect: Changes the Pokémon's type to the type of the move it's about to use. This works only once each time the Pokémon enters battle.
short_effect: Libero changes the Pokémon's type to that of its previously used attack.

name: Light Metal
effect: Halves the Pokémon's weight.
short_effect: Halves the Pokémon's weight.

name: Lightning Rod
effect: The Pokémon draws in all Electric-type moves. Instead of taking damage from them, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted.
short_effect: Redirects single-target Electric moves to this Pokémon where possible.  Absorbs Electric moves, raising Special Attack one stage.

name: Limber
effect: The Pokémon's limber body prevents it from being paralyzed.
short_effect: Prevents paralysis.

name: Lingering Aroma
effect: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker's Ability to Lingering Aroma.
short_effect: Contact changes the attacker's Ability to Lingering Aroma.

name: Liquid Ooze
effect: The strong stench of the Pokémon's oozed liquid damages attackers that use HP-draining moves.
short_effect: Damages opponents using leeching moves for as much as they would heal.

name: Liquid Voice
effect: Sound-based moves become Water-type moves.
short_effect: Sound-based moves become Water-type.

name: Long Reach
effect: The Pokémon uses its moves without making contact with the target.
short_effect: This Pokémon's moves do not make contact.

name: Magic Bounce
effect: The Pokémon reflects status moves instead of getting hit by them.
short_effect: Reflects most non-damaging moves back at their user.

name: Magic Guard
effect: The Pokémon only takes damage from attacks.
short_effect: Protects against damage not directly caused by a move.

name: Magician
effect: The Pokémon steals the held item from any target it hits with a move.
short_effect: Steals the target's held item when the bearer uses a damaging move.

name: Magma Armor
effect: The Pokémon’s hot magma coating prevents it from being frozen.
short_effect: Prevents freezing.

name: Magnet Pull
effect: Prevents Steel-type Pokémon from fleeing by pulling them in with magnetism.
short_effect: Prevents Steel opponents from fleeing or switching out.

name: Marvel Scale
effect: The Pokémon's marvelous scales boost its Defense stat if it has a status condition.
short_effect: Increases Defense to 1.5× with a major status ailment.

name: Mega Launcher
effect: Powers up pulse moves.
short_effect: Strengthens aura and pulse moves to 1.5× their power.

name: Mega Sol
effect: Even when the sunlight has not turned harsh, the Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.
short_effect: The Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.

name: Merciless
effect: The Pokémon's attacks become critical hits if the target is poisoned.
short_effect: This Pokémon's moves critical hit against poisoned targets.

name: Mimicry
effect: Changes the Pokémon’s type depending on the terrain.
short_effect: Changes type depending on the terrain.

name: Mind’s Eye
effect: The Pokémon ignores changes to opponents' evasiveness, its accuracy can't be lowered, and it can hit Ghost types with Normal-type and Fighting-type moves
short_effect: The Pokémon ignores changes to opponents' evasiveness, its accuracy can't be lowered, and it can hit Ghost types with Normal- and Fighting-type moves.

name: Minus
effect: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat of the Pokémon if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.
short_effect: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× when a friendly Pokémon has Plus or Minus.

name: Mirror Armor
effect: Bounces back only the stat-lowering effects that the Pokémon receives.
short_effect: Reflects any stat-lowering effects.

name: Misty Surge
effect: Turns the ground into Misty Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.
short_effect: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Misty Terrain.

name: Mold Breaker
effect: The Pokémon's moves are unimpeded by the Ability of the target.
short_effect: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent a move.

name: Moody
effect: Every turn, one of the Pokémon's stats will be boosted sharply but another stat will be lowered.
short_effect: Raises a random stat two stages and lowers another one stage after each turn.

name: Motor Drive
effect: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Electric-type moves. Instead, its Speed stat is boosted.
short_effect: Absorbs Electric moves, raising Speed one stage.

name: Moxie
effect: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it shows moxie, which boosts its Attack stat.
short_effect: Raises Attack one stage upon KOing a Pokémon.

name: Multiscale
effect: Reduces the amount of damage the Pokémon takes while its HP is full.
short_effect: Halves damage taken from full HP.

name: Multitype
effect: Changes the Pokémon's type to match the plate it holds.
short_effect: Changes Arceus's type and form to match its held Plate.

name: Mummy
effect: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker’s Ability to Mummy.
short_effect: Changes attacking Pokémon's abilities to Mummy on contact.

name: Mycelium Might
effect: The Pokémon will always act more slowly when using status moves, but these moves will be unimpeded by the Ability of the target.
short_effect: Status moves go last, but are not affected by the opponent's ability.

name: Natural Cure
effect: The Pokémon's status conditions are cured when it switches out.
short_effect: Cures any major status ailment upon switching out.

name: Neuroforce
effect: Powers up moves that are super effective.
short_effect: Increases super-effective damage dealt to 1.25×.

name: Neutralizing Gas
effect: While the Pokémon is in the battle, the effects of all other Pokémon's Abilities will be nullified or will not be triggered.
short_effect: Neutralizes abilities of all Pokémon in battle.

name: No Guard
effect: The Pokémon employs no-guard tactics to ensure incoming and outgoing attacks always land.
short_effect: Ensures all moves used by and against the Pokémon hit.

name: Normalize
effect: All the Pokémon’s moves become Normal type. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
short_effect: Makes the Pokémon's moves all act Normal-type.

name: Oblivious
effect: The Pokémon is oblivious, keeping it from being infatuated, falling for taunts, or being affected by Intimidate.
short_effect: Prevents infatuation and protects against Captivate.

name: Opportunist
effect: If an opponent's stat is boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost the same stat for itself.
short_effect: Copies stat boosts by the opponent.

name: Orichalcum Pulse
effect: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle. The ancient pulse thrumming through the Pokémon also boosts its Attack stat in harsh sunlight.
short_effect: Turns the sunlight harsh when entering battle, and boosts Attack while active.

name: Overcoat
effect: The Pokémon takes no damage from sandstorms. It is also protected from the effects of powders and spores.
short_effect: Protects against damage from weather.

name: Overgrow
effect: Powers up Grass-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.
short_effect: Strengthens Grass moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

name: Own Tempo
effect: The Pokémon sticks to its own tempo, preventing it from becoming confused or being affected by Intimidate.
short_effect: Prevents confusion.

name: Parental Bond
effect: Parent and child each attacks.
short_effect: Lets the bearer hit twice with damaging moves.  The second hit has half power.

name: Pastel Veil
effect: Protects the Pokémon and its ally Pokémon from being poisoned.
short_effect: Prevents the Pokémon and its allies from being poisoned.

name: Perish Body
effect: When hit by a move that makes direct contact, the Pokémon and the attacker will faint after three turns unless they switch out of battle.
short_effect: When hit by a move that makes direct contact, the Pokémon and the attacker will faint after three turns unless they switch out of battle.

name: Pickpocket
effect: The Pokémon steals the held item from attackers that made direct contact with it.
short_effect: Steals attacking Pokémon's held items on contact.

name: Pickup
effect: The Pokémon may pick up an item another Pokémon used during a battle. It may pick up items outside of battle, too.
short_effect: Picks up other Pokémon's used and Flung held items.  May also pick up an item after battle.

name: Piercing Drill
effect: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target's protective effects is still triggered.
short_effect: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves.

name: Pixilate
effect: Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
short_effect: Turns the bearer's Normal moves into Fairy moves and strengthens them to 1.3× their power.

name: Plus
effect: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat of the Pokémon if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.
short_effect: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× when a friendly Pokémon has Plus or Minus.

name: Poison Heal
effect: If poisoned, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.
short_effect: Heals for 1/8 max HP after each turn when poisoned in place of damage.

name: Poison Point
effect: Contact with the Pokémon may poison the attacker.
short_effect: Has a 30% chance of poisoning attacking Pokémon on contact.

name: Poison Puppeteer
effect: Pokémon poisoned by Pecharunt's moves will also become confused.
short_effect: Pokémon poisoned by Pecharunt's moves will also become confused.

name: Poison Touch
effect: May poison a target when the Pokémon makes contact.
short_effect: Has a 30% chance of poisoning target Pokémon upon contact.

name: Power Construct
effect: Other Cells gather to aid when its HP becomes half or less. Then the Pokémon changes its form to Complete Forme.
short_effect: Transforms 10% or 50% Zygarde into Complete Forme when its HP is below 50%.

name: Power of Alchemy
effect: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.
short_effect: When an ally faints, this Pokémon gains its Ability.

name: Power Spot
effect: Just being next to the Pokémon powers up moves.
short_effect: Just being next to the Pokémon powers up moves.

name: Prankster
effect: Gives priority to the Pokémon's status moves.
short_effect: Raises non-damaging moves' priority by one stage.

name: Pressure
effect: Puts other Pokémon under pressure, causing them to expend more PP to use their moves.
short_effect: Increases the PP cost of moves targetting the Pokémon by one.

name: Primordial Sea
effect: The Pokémon changes the weather to nullify Fire-type attacks.
short_effect: Creates heavy rain, which has all the properties of Rain Dance, cannot be replaced, and causes damaging Fire moves to fail.

name: Prism Armor
effect: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks taken.
short_effect: Reduces super-effective damage to 0.75×.

name: Propeller Tail
effect: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's Abilities and moves that draw in moves.
short_effect: Ignores moves and abilities that draw in moves.

name: Protean
effect: Changes the Pokémon's type to the type of the move it's about to use. This works only once each time the Pokémon enters battle.
short_effect: Changes the bearer's type to match each move it uses.

name: Protosynthesis
effect: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.
short_effect: Raises highest stat in harsh sunlight, or if holding Booster Energy.

name: Psychic Surge
effect: Turns the ground into Psychic Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.
short_effect: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Psychic Terrain.

name: Punk Rock
effect: Boosts the power of sound-based moves. The Pokémon also takes half the damage from these kinds of moves.
short_effect: Boosts sound-based moves and halves damage from the same moves.

name: Pure Power
effect: Using its pure power, the Pokémon doubles its Attack stat.
short_effect: Doubles Attack in battle.

name: Purifying Salt
effect: The Pokémon's pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.
short_effect: Protects from status conditions and halves damage from Ghost-type moves.

name: Quark Drive
effect: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat on Electric Terrain or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.
short_effect: Raises highest stat on Electric Terrain, or if holding Booster Energy.

name: Queenly Majesty
effect: When the Pokémon uses Surf or Dive, it will come back with prey. When it takes damage, it will spit out the prey to attack.
short_effect: Opposing Pokémon cannot use priority attacks.

name: Quick Draw
effect: Enables the Pokémon to move first occasionally.
short_effect: Enables the Pokémon to move first occasionally.

name: Quick Feet
effect: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon has a status condition.
short_effect: Increases Speed to 1.5× with a major status ailment.

name: Rain Dish
effect: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in rain.
short_effect: Heals for 1/16 max HP after each turn during rain.

name: Rattled
effect: The Pokémon gets scared when hit by a Dark-, Ghost-, or Bug-type attack or if intimidated, which boosts its Speed stat.
short_effect: Raises Speed one stage upon being hit by a Dark, Ghost, or Bug move.

name: Receiver
effect: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.
short_effect: When an ally faints, this Pokémon gains its Ability.

name: Reckless
effect: Powers up moves that have recoil damage.
short_effect: Strengthens recoil moves to 1.2× their power.

name: Refrigerate
effect: Normal-type moves become Ice-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
short_effect: Turns the bearer's Normal moves into Ice moves and strengthens them to 1.3× their power.

name: Regenerator
effect: The Pokémon has a little of its HP restored when withdrawn from battle.
short_effect: Heals for 1/3 max HP upon switching out.

name: Ripen
effect: Ripens Berries and doubles their effect.
short_effect: Doubles the effect of berries.

name: Rivalry
effect: The Pokémon's competitive spirit makes it deal more damage to Pokémon of the same gender, but less damage to Pokémon of the opposite gender.
short_effect: Increases damage inflicted to 1.25× against Pokémon of the same gender, but decreases damage to 0.75× against the opposite gender.

name: RKS System
effect: Changes the Pokémon’s type to match the memory disc it holds.
short_effect: Changes this Pokémon's type to match its held Memory.

name: Rock Head
effect: Protects the Pokémon from recoil damage.
short_effect: Protects against recoil damage.

name: Rocky Payload
effect: Powers up Rock-type moves.
short_effect: Powers up Rock-type moves.

name: Rough Skin
effect: The Pokémon's rough skin damages attackers that make direct contact with it.
short_effect: Damages attacking Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP on contact.

name: Run Away
effect: Enables a sure getaway from wild Pokémon.
short_effect: Ensures success fleeing from wild battles.

name: Sand Force
effect: Boosts the power of Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type moves in a sandstorm.
short_effect: Strengthens Rock, Ground, and Steel moves to 1.3× their power during a sandstorm.  Protects against sandstorm damage.

name: Sand Rush
effect: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in a sandstorm.
short_effect: Doubles Speed during a sandstorm.  Protects against sandstorm damage.

name: Sand Spit
effect: The Pokémon creates a sandstorm when it's hit by an attack.
short_effect: Creates a sandstorm when hit by an attack.

name: Sand Stream
effect: The Pokémon summons a sandstorm when it enters a battle.
short_effect: Summons a sandstorm that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.

name: Sand Veil
effect: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness in a sandstorm.
short_effect: Increases evasion to 1.25× during a sandstorm.  Protects against sandstorm damage.

name: Sap Sipper
effect: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Grass-type moves. Instead, its Attack stat is boosted.
short_effect: Absorbs Grass moves, raising Attack one stage.

name: Schooling
effect: When it has a lot of HP, the Pokémon forms a powerful school. It stops schooling when its HP is low.
short_effect: Wishiwashi becomes Schooling Form when its HP is 25% or higher.

name: Scrappy
effect: The Pokémon can hit Ghost-type Pokémon with Normal- and Fighting-type moves. It is also unaffected by Intimidate.
short_effect: Lets the Pokémon's Normal and Fighting moves hit Ghost Pokémon.

name: Screen Cleaner
effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for both opposing and ally Pokémon.
short_effect: Nullifies effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil.

name: Seed Sower
effect: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.
short_effect: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.

name: Serene Grace
effect: Raises the likelihood of additional effects occurring when the Pokémon uses its moves.
short_effect: Doubles the chance of moves' extra effects occurring.

name: Shadow Shield
effect: Reduces the amount of damage the Pokémon takes while its HP is full.
short_effect: When this Pokémon has full HP, regular damage from moves is halved.

name: Shadow Tag
effect: The Pokémon steps on the opposing Pokémon's shadows to prevent them from fleeing or switching out.
short_effect: Prevents opponents from fleeing or switching out.

name: Sharpness
effect: Powers up slicing moves.
short_effect: Powers up slicing moves.

name: Shed Skin
effect: The Pokémon may cure its own status conditions by shedding its skin.
short_effect: Has a 33% chance of curing any major status ailment after each turn.

name: Sheer Force
effect: Removes any additional effects from the Pokémon's moves, but increases the moves' power.
short_effect: Strengthens moves with extra effects to 1.3× their power, but prevents their extra effects.

name: Shell Armor
effect: A hard shell protects the Pokémon from critical hits.
short_effect: Protects against critical hits.

name: Shield Dust
effect: Protective dust shields the Pokémon from the additional effects of moves.
short_effect: Protects against incoming moves' extra effects.

name: Shields Down
effect: When its HP drops to half or less, the Pokémon's shell breaks and it becomes aggressive.
short_effect: Transforms this Minior between Core Form and Meteor Form.  Prevents major status ailments and drowsiness while in Meteor Form.

name: Simple
effect: Doubles the effects of the Pokémon's stat changes.
short_effect: Doubles the Pokémon's stat modifiers.  These doubled modifiers are still capped at -6 or 6 stages.

name: Skill Link
effect: Maximizes the number of times multistrike moves hit.
short_effect: Extends two-to-five-hit moves and Triple Kick to their full length every time.

name: Slow Start
effect: For five turns, the Pokémon's Attack and Speed stats are halved.
short_effect: Halves Attack and Speed for five turns upon entering battle.

name: Slush Rush
effect: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in snow.
short_effect: During Hail, this Pokémon has double Speed.

name: Sniper
effect: If the Pokémon's attack lands a critical hit, the attack is powered up even further.
short_effect: Strengthens critical hits to inflict 3× damage rather than 2×.

name: Snow Cloak
effect: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness in snow.
short_effect: Increases evasion to 1.25× during hail.  Protects against hail damage.

name: Snow Warning
effect: The Pokémon makes it snow when it enters a battle.
short_effect: Summons hail that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.

name: Solar Power
effect: In harsh sunlight, the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat is boosted, but its HP decreases every turn.
short_effect: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× but costs 1/8 max HP after each turn during strong sunlight.

name: Solid Rock
effect: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks that hit the Pokémon.
short_effect: Decreases damage taken from super-effective moves by 1/4.

name: Soul-Heart
effect: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat every time another Pokémon faints.
short_effect: This Pokémon's Special Attack rises by one stage every time any Pokémon faints.

name: Soundproof
effect: Soundproofing gives the Pokémon full immunity to all sound-based moves.
short_effect: Protects against sound-based moves.

name: Speed Boost
effect: The Pokémon's Speed stat is boosted every turn.
short_effect: Raises Speed one stage after each turn.

name: Spicy Spray
effect: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.
short_effect: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.

name: Stakeout
effect: Doubles the damage dealt to a target that has just switched into battle.
short_effect: This Pokémon's moves have double power against Pokémon that switched in this turn.

name: Stall
effect: The Pokémon is always the last to use its moves.
short_effect: Makes the Pokémon move last within its move's priority bracket.

name: Stalwart
effect: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's Abilities and moves that draw in moves.
short_effect: Ignores moves and abilities that draw in moves.

name: Stamina
effect: Boosts the Defense stat when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.
short_effect: Raises this Pokémon's Defense by one stage when it takes damage from a move.

name: Stance Change
effect: The Pokémon changes its form to Blade Forme when it uses an attack move and changes to Shield Forme when it uses King’s Shield.
short_effect: Changes Aegislash to Blade Forme before using a damaging move, or Shield Forme before using King’s Shield.

name: Static
effect: The Pokémon is charged with static electricity and may paralyze attackers that make direct contact with it.
short_effect: Has a 30% chance of paralyzing attacking Pokémon on contact.

name: Steadfast
effect: The Pokémon's determination boosts its Speed stat every time it flinches.
short_effect: Raises Speed one stage upon flinching.

name: Steam Engine
effect: Boosts the Speed stat drastically when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire- or Water-type move.
short_effect: Boosts the Speed stat drastically when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire- or Water-type move.

name: Steelworker
effect: Powers up Steel-type moves.
short_effect: This Pokémon's Steel moves have 1.5× power.

name: Steely Spirit
effect: Powers up the Steel-type moves of the Pokémon and its allies.
short_effect: Powers up ally Pokémon's Steel-type moves.

name: Stench
effect: By releasing a stench when attacking, the Pokémon may cause the target to flinch.
short_effect: Has a 10% chance of making target Pokémon flinch with each hit.

name: Sticky Hold
effect: The Pokémon's held items cling to its sticky body and cannot be removed by other Pokémon.
short_effect: Prevents a held item from being removed by other Pokémon.

name: Storm Drain
effect: The Pokémon draws in all Water-type moves. Instead of taking damage from them, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted.
short_effect: Redirects single-target Water moves to this Pokémon where possible.  Absorbs Water moves, raising Special Attack one stage.

name: Strong Jaw
effect: The Pokémon's strong jaw boosts the power of its biting moves.
short_effect: Strengthens biting moves to 1.5× their power.

name: Sturdy
effect: The Pokémon cannot be knocked out by a single hit as long as its HP is full. One-hit KO moves will also fail to knock it out.
short_effect: Prevents being KOed from full HP, leaving 1 HP instead.  Protects against the one-hit KO moves regardless of HP.

name: Suction Cups
effect: The Pokémon uses suction cups to stay in one spot. This protects it from moves and items that would force it to switch out.
short_effect: Prevents being forced out of battle by other Pokémon's moves.

name: Super Luck
effect: The Pokémon is so lucky that the critical-hit ratios of its moves are boosted.
short_effect: Raises moves' critical hit rates one stage.

name: Supersweet Syrup
effect: Lowers the evasion of opposing Pokémon by 1 stage when first sent into battle
short_effect: Once per battle, when a Pokémon with Supersweet Syrup enters the battle, it lowers the evasion stat of all adjacent opponents by one stage.

name: Supreme Overlord
effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are slightly boosted for each of the allies in its party that have already been defeated.
short_effect: Attack and Special Attack are boosted for each party Pokémon that has been defeated.

name: Surge Surfer
effect: Doubles the Pokémon's Speed stat on Electric Terrain.
short_effect: Doubles this Pokémon's Speed on Electric Terrain.

name: Swarm
effect: Powers up Bug-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.
short_effect: Strengthens Bug moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

name: Sweet Veil
effect: Prevents the Pokémon and its allies from falling asleep.
short_effect: Prevents friendly Pokémon from sleeping.

name: Swift Swim
effect: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in rain.
short_effect: Doubles Speed during rain.

name: Sword of Ruin
effect: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous sword lowers the Defense stats of all Pokémon except itself.
short_effect: Lowers Defense of all Pokémon except itself.

name: Symbiosis
effect: The Pokémon passes its held item to an ally that has used up an item.
short_effect: Passes the bearer's held item to an ally when the ally uses up its item.

name: Synchronize
effect: If the Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned by another Pokémon, that Pokémon will be inflicted with the same status condition.
short_effect: Copies burns, paralysis, and poison received onto the Pokémon that inflicted them.

name: Tablets of Ruin
effect: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous wooden tablets lowers the Attack stats of all Pokémon except itself.
short_effect: Lowers Attack of all Pokémon except itself.

name: Tangled Feet
effect: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness if it is confused.
short_effect: Doubles evasion when confused.

name: Tangling Hair
effect: Contact with the Pokémon lowers the attacker's Speed stat.
short_effect: When this Pokémon takes regular damage from a contact move, the attacking Pokémon's Speed lowers by one stage.

name: Technician
effect: Powers up weak moves so the Pokémon can deal more damage with them.
short_effect: Strengthens moves of 60 base power or less to 1.5× their power.

name: Telepathy
effect: The Pokémon anticipates and dodges the attacks of its allies.
short_effect: Protects against friendly Pokémon's damaging moves.

name: Teraform Zero
effect: When Terapagos changes into its Stellar Form, it uses its hidden powers to eliminate all effects of weather and terrain, reducing them to zero.
short_effect: As soon as Terapagos assumes its Stellar Form, it will immediately neutralize weather and terrain effects.

name: Tera Shell
effect: The Pokémon's shell contains the powers of each type. All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.
short_effect: All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.

name: Tera Shift
effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it absorbs the energy around itself and transforms into its Terastal Form.
short_effect: When Terapagos enters the battle, it turns into its Terastal Form until the end of the battle.

name: Teravolt
effect: The Pokémon's moves are unimpeded by the Ability of the target.
short_effect: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent moves.

name: Thermal Exchange
effect: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.
short_effect: Raises Attack when hit by a Fire-type move. Cannot be burned.

name: Thick Fat
effect: The Pokémon is protected by a layer of thick fat, which halves the damage taken from Fire- and Ice-type moves.
short_effect: Halves damage from Fire and Ice moves.

name: Tinted Lens
effect: The Pokémon can use “not very effective” moves to deal regular damage.
short_effect: Doubles damage inflicted with not-very-effective moves.

name: Torrent
effect: Powers up Water-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.
short_effect: Strengthens Water moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

name: Tough Claws
effect: Powers up moves that make direct contact.
short_effect: Strengthens moves that make contact to 1.33× their power.

name: Toxic Boost
effect: Powers up physical moves when the Pokémon is poisoned.
short_effect: Increases Attack to 1.5× when poisoned.

name: Toxic Chain
effect: The power of the Pokémon's toxic chain may badly poison any target the Pokémon hits with a move
short_effect: May cause bad poisoning when the Pokémon hits an opponent with a move.

name: Toxic Debris
effect: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.
short_effect: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.

name: Trace
effect: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon copies an opposing Pokémon's Ability.
short_effect: Copies an opponent's ability upon entering battle.

name: Transistor
effect: Powers up Electric-type moves.
short_effect: Powers up Electric-type moves.

name: Triage
effect: Gives priority to the Pokémon's healing moves.
short_effect: This Pokémon's healing moves have their priority increased by 3.

name: Truant
effect: Each time the Pokémon uses a move, it spends the next turn loafing around.
short_effect: Skips every second turn.

name: Turboblaze
effect: The Pokémon's moves are unimpeded by the Ability of the target.
short_effect: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent moves.

name: Unaware
effect: When attacking, the Pokémon ignores the target's stat changes.
short_effect: Ignores other Pokémon's stat modifiers for damage and accuracy calculation.

name: Unburden
effect: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon's held item is used or lost.
short_effect: Doubles Speed upon using or losing a held item.

name: Unnerve
effect: Unnerves opposing Pokémon and makes them unable to eat Berries.
short_effect: Prevents opposing Pokémon from eating held Berries.

name: Unseen Fist
effect: If the Pokémon uses moves that make direct contact, it can attack the target even if the target protects itself.
short_effect: Contact moves can strike through Protect/Detect.

name: Vessel of Ruin
effect: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous vessel lowers the Sp. Atk stats of all Pokémon except itself.
short_effect: Lowers Special Attack of all Pokémon except itself.

name: Victory Star
effect: Boosts the accuracy of its allies and itself.
short_effect: Increases moves' accuracy to 1.1× for friendly Pokémon.

name: Vital Spirit
effect: The Pokémon is full of vitality, and that prevents it from falling asleep.
short_effect: Prevents sleep.

name: Volt Absorb
effect: If hit by an Electric-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.
short_effect: Absorbs Electric moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.

name: Wandering Spirit
effect: The Pokémon exchanges Abilities with a Pokémon that hits it with a move that makes direct contact.
short_effect: Swaps abilities with opponents on contact.

name: Water Absorb
effect: If hit by a Water-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.
short_effect: Absorbs Water moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.

name: Water Bubble
effect: Lowers the power of Fire-type moves that hit the Pokémon and prevents it from being burned.
short_effect: Halves damage from Fire moves, doubles damage of Water moves, and prevents burns.

name: Water Compaction
effect: Boosts the Defense stat sharply when the Pokémon is hit by a Water-type move.
short_effect: Raises this Pokémon's Defense by two stages when it's hit by a Water move.

name: Water Veil
effect: The Pokémon's water veil prevents it from being burned.
short_effect: Prevents burns.

name: Weak Armor
effect: The Pokémon's Defense stat is lowered when it takes damage from physical moves, but its Speed stat is sharply boosted.
short_effect: Raises Speed and lowers Defense by one stage each upon being hit by a physical move.

name: Well-Baked Body
effect: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Fire-type moves. Instead, its Defense stat is sharply boosted.
short_effect: Immune to Fire-type moves, and Defense is sharply boosted.

name: White Smoke
effect: The Pokémon is protected by its white smoke, which prevents other Pokémon from lowering its stats.
short_effect: Prevents stats from being lowered by other Pokémon.

name: Wimp Out
effect: The Pokémon cowardly switches out when its HP becomes half or less.
short_effect: This Pokémon automatically switches out when its HP drops below half.

name: Wind Power
effect: The Pokémon becomes charged when it is hit by a wind move, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.
short_effect: When hit by a wind move, the power of the next Electric-type move it uses is doubled.

name: Wind Rider
effect: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.
short_effect: Gives immunity to wind moves, and causes the Pokémon's Attack to increase by one stage when hit by one.

name: Wonder Guard
effect: Its mysterious power only lets supereffective moves hit the Pokémon.
short_effect: Protects against damaging moves that are not super effective.

name: Wonder Skin
effect: Makes status moves more likely to miss the Pokémon.
short_effect: Lowers incoming non-damaging moves' base accuracy to exactly 50%.

name: Zen Mode
effect: Changes the Pokémon’s shape when HP is half or less.
short_effect: Changes Darmanitan's form after each turn depending on its HP: Zen Mode below 50% max HP, and Standard Mode otherwise.

name: Zero to Hero
effect: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out.
short_effect: Transforms into its Hero Form when switching out.
